Requests for combined shipping will be handled on a case-by-case basis. It may not be possible to combine multiple large items or lots of items.
Combined shipping will not be adjusted after payment has been made.
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a PO Box.
We work to ship orders within
5 business days
of payment however; we make every effort to ship sooner.
Please verify your shipping address is correct before completing payment.
Goodwill Retail Services is not responsible for stolen merchandise after delivery is confirmed with tracking info.
Goodwill Retail Services is not responsible for damaged or lost packages due to mishandling by the shipping providers.
Refunds issued for items damaged in transit by the shipping provider will be handled on a case by case basis, please contact us for further information.
Additional shipping services are available.
Please contact us for shipping insurance, and signature required. Fees for additional services may apply.
Items over $1000 will require signature confirmation.
Items over $1000 will require increased insurance.
